standard.summary: Step Expert 会按 denoise 时间步在多个 LoRA 专家之间路由，适合 Turbo / few-step 学生路线。由 step_expert_enabled 开启，专家数与分界由 step_expert_num_experts / step_expert_boundaries 决定。
standard.effect: 不同步数区间走不同专家，提升 few-step 适配容量；adapter 需要 live routing，不能静态合并成普通 LoRA。开启时 Step Expert 与 ChimeraHydra 互斥，同时要求 network_train_unet_only=true。
standard.whenToUse: 做 DP-DMD / Turbo 学生、且能接受 adapter 必须带 live routing 加载时。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要可合并、可由普通推理端加载的普通 LoRA；或同时想开 ChimeraHydra（二者互斥）。

standard_en.summary: Step Expert routes between several LoRA experts along the denoise step, which suits Turbo / few-step student routes. Turn it on with step_expert_enabled; the expert count and boundaries come from step_expert_num_experts / step_expert_boundaries.
standard_en.effect: Different step ranges go through different experts, raising few-step adaptation capacity; the adapter then needs live routing and cannot be merged into an ordinary LoRA. Step Expert is mutually exclusive with ChimeraHydra and requires network_train_unet_only=true.
standard_en.whenToUse: When building a DP-DMD / Turbo student and you can accept an adapter that must be loaded with live routing.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need a mergeable LoRA that an ordinary inference frontend can load, or you also want ChimeraHydra (the two are mutually exclusive).

advanced.principle: StepExpertInjector 用 ContextVar 把采样时间步传给每层，专家分界是 num_experts 均分（也可显式给 boundaries）；up-proj 零初始化，因此 init 时是精确恒等。
advanced.intervention: Turbo denoise step context → live LoRA expert routing。
advanced.expectedImpact: 完整接入后可能改善 few-step 质量，但会增加 adapter 参数和推理端要求。
advanced.tradeoffs: 专家数越多容量越大、显存与文件体积也越大；训练产物依赖 live routing，跨前端可移植性下降。 该能力当前不在 WebUI 训练 schema 内：后端字段 step_expert_enabled / step_expert_boundaries / step_expert_num_experts 只能由 TOML 或手写请求设置。

advanced_en.principle: StepExpertInjector passes the sampling timestep down through a ContextVar; expert boundaries are an even split of num_experts unless boundaries are given explicitly. The up-projection is zero-initialised, so at init the adapter is the exact identity.
advanced_en.intervention: Turbo denoise step context → live LoRA expert routing.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Once fully wired in, may improve few-step quality, but adds adapter parameters and inference-side requirements.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: More experts mean more capacity but also more VRAM and a larger file; the trained artifact then depends on live routing and is less portable across frontends. This capability is not part of the WebUI training schema right now: the backend fields step_expert_enabled / step_expert_boundaries / step_expert_num_experts are settable from TOML or a hand-written request only.
